description: Bounded probe, after 09: re-apply the mobile emulation on the loaded page and read devicePixelRatio and the canvas backing store. s4 (Playwright screenshot at the end of 09) read DPR 1 while the canvas stayed 1170x2532. s7 (CDP captures only) read DPR 3, screen 390x844 and canvas 1170x2532, and the emulate assertion passed. On a self-authored fixture, Playwright's page.screenshot() reset DPR to 1 and the screen to 800x600 until the next navigation. Run it last in a session.
